constructionPolicy.positive: us-ssn-sha256-v1: SHA-256 of the case seed maps to area 001-899 without 666, group 01-99 and serial 0001-9999. No person, SSA, registry, issuance or lookup provenance; the value exists only to exercise the structurally admissible path.
constructionPolicy.exclusions: SSA RM 10201.035 exclusions (area 000, 666, 900-999; group 00; serial 0000) are one-component overrides of a generated value, declared as candidate twins.
constructionPolicy.displayControl: SSA RM 10201.020 display replicas (000-00-0000 and other 000-area combinations) are identity-invalid controls, never non-sensitive identities: us-ssn-v1 has no structurally valid non-sensitive namespace.
constructionPolicy.placeholder: #408/#411: a placeholder is benign only when it is type-invalid. A structurally valid SSN under an unlisted placeholder, sample or test label is authored sensitive, as us-ssn-v1 says those words do not suppress.
constructionPolicy.context: Sensitivity follows us-ssn-v1 and pii-context/v1 only: en ssn / social security number, ko 사회보장번호 / 사회 보장 번호 / 미국 사회보장번호 field labels, with example/documentation/예시 and not ssn/사회보장번호 아님 as occurrence exclusions. Generic id, national id, tax id, account, order and reference labels have no authority.

nonGoals: a second jurisdiction or national-ID family (core #795 stays conditional)

baseRate.rationale: Balanced diagnosis of the context and allocation boundary; us-ssn-v1 has no structurally valid non-sensitive namespace, so the non-sensitive stratum is empty by contract.
Operational text dominated by nine-digit references, placeholders and negated or unassociated labels, with a small declared sensitive share so sensitive miss rate is measurable.

derivedFrom.method: Every predecessor case is kept with its id, candidate and context. The three #426 parenthesized-label corrections (evidence/901/426/pii-c3-reviewed-corrections-v1.json) become native authored truth; no US SSN or phone case changes under pii-context/v2; new independent cases are appended. No case was added, removed or relabelled from a scan.
